The publication-disabled simulated-Actions build-core run and independent native-local build-core run reproduced both ABI artifacts, metadata, warning-free build logs, and package byte for byte. The pristine source is commit bf816b096f1dca55ea805337d7c9e78d6b98d839, tree 96122db14e9117e875c7ecaec7e77519e8be5636, with no submodules. ARM64 requires GLIBC_2.17 and GLIBCXX_3.4.15. ARMHF requires GLIBC_2.4, GLIBCXX_3.4.15, and libm in addition to libc, libgcc_s, and libstdc++; loader, C++ runtime, and rootfs execution must pass before any device selection.
Resolver metadata declares GPLv2; any public distribution or release remains a human legal/policy and corresponding-source gate even though local builds reproduce.

TGB Dual's two-ROM local-player link-cable behavior, per-player input, screen switching or combined display, audio routing, and linked save/state behavior require explicit device tests.
No firmware or BIOS is declared or packaged by the pinned resolver metadata, so no firmware requirement is inferred from static evidence.

ARM64 is build-identity-bound only to ra64-universal-v1 and ARMHF only to ra32-a30-v1. Candidate Pixel2, Mini-family, and broader universal mappings remain unproven pending provider, loader, rootfs, frontend, and target-runtime capture; all device views remain ineligible.
